# Sickwear

> Sickwear makes custom merchandise for Web3 projects, events, communities and brands. Made in India, shipped to 150+ countries, payable in crypto or fiat.

## Key facts

- Products: apparel, accessories, bags, leather goods, drinkware, gadgets, stationery, event items, gift hampers
- Minimum order: typically 50 units for standard items; smaller premium runs on request
- Production: 2-3 weeks from design approval; 7-10 days expedited; 3-4 weeks for 500+ units
- Shipping: 150+ countries, with tracking
- Payment: USDC, USDT, ETH and other major tokens, wire transfer, card
- Branding: screen print, embroidery, DTG, sublimation, NFC-enabled merch
- Samples: available on request
- Contact: sickwear.xyz@gmail.com, Telegram @siddyb26 or @aoife05, X @sickwear_xyz

- [Home](https://www.sickwear.xyz): products, process, gallery, clients, FAQ and contact form

- [Event merch](https://www.sickwear.xyz/event-merch): merch for hackathons, conferences and community events
- [Global presence](https://www.sickwear.xyz/overview): where Sickwear has delivered
